summary: Operator site and Campspot confirm 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/store/free basic Wi-Fi, Campspot booking; added the one-month maximum and site classes; cleared the directory-only military flag. Fees left as quoted on Campspot 2026-10-13 ($45.50-68.25), but the park's own rates page lists higher, undated prices (flagged). Not stated: total site count (60 left), max rig length, season.
flags: Price conflict near the US$50 gate: the park's own rates page (https://www.blcrv.com/rates/, undated) lists Partial $55.04, Companion $57.77, Standard $60.50 and Deluxe $71.40 a night plus tax, while Campspot quoted $45.50 for the cheapest RV type on 2026-10-13 (fees kept from Campspot, the engine that sells the night). If the website's prices are current the base is over US$50 with no gateway (Myrtle Beach 95 km) and the park is not a Good Sam Park. The family has not stayed here.
